method: requirements-check-1 (Sonnet 5 judge + Sonnet 5 check; disagreements unknown; quotes verified)

evidence.quote: Adds a localhost-only Zotero bridge for Zotero Copilot desktop workflows.
ZoteroCopilot seamlessly connects AI assistants to your local Zotero library for hands-free literature management.

checkNote: This is a localhost bridge that lets external AI assistants (Codex, Claude Code) reach Zotero. Its sharedSecret is auto-generated locally ("generateSharedSecret()"), not supplied by the user. The plugin has no AI model calls of its own, only 127.0.0.1.
